scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/semanticdam/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/semanticdam
  set jcr:title{String} to "AEM Assets Metadata"
end

set ACL for aem-assets-metadata-svc
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /content/cq:tags
  allow jcr:read on /conf/semanticdam/settings/ontology
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement on /var/semanticdam/graph
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement on /var/semanticdam/entities
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement on /var/semanticdam/proposals
end

set ACL for aem-assets-metadata-svc
  allow jcr:modifyProperties on /content/dam restriction(rep:glob,*/jcr:content/metadata/semanticdam:*)
end

set ACL for semanticdam-invalidation-svc
  allow jcr:read,crx:replicate on /content
end
